content.short: Agora is a set of Plutus scripts that compose together to form a governance system.
content.description:
Agora is a set of Plutus scripts that compose together to form a governance system. It provides a one size fits all governance library for projects on Cardano. It aims to be modular and flexible though uses an opinionated architecture.

Originally it was set up to reduce duplication in Liqwid and XplorerDAO. It has subsequently been used in a range of projects including Summon’s platform . It was originally created by Liqwid.
